    assert argv[argv.index("-m") + 1] == "sglang_simulator.baseline.launch_server"
    assert argv[argv.index("--device") + 1] == "cuda"
    assert "--disable-overlap-schedule" in argv and "--disable-cuda-graph" in argv
    prefix_delta = Counter()
    output_counts = []

        assert req_infos and len({str(req["rid"]) for req in req_infos}) == len(req_infos)
        prefixes, outputs, physical_lengths = [], [], []
        for req in req_infos:
            raw_req = requests[str(req["rid"])]
            input_len = int(raw_req["input_length"])
            assert input_len == len(raw_req["input_ids"])
            output_len = int(req["output_ids_len"])
            assert int(req["extend_input_len"]) == 1
            assert 1 <= output_len < int(raw_req["output_length"])
            prefix = int(req["prefix_indices_len"])
            assert prefix >= 0
            prefix_delta[prefix - input_len] += 1
            output_counts.append(output_len)
            histories[str(req["rid"])].append(output_len)
            prefixes.append(prefix)
            outputs.append(output_len)
            physical_lengths.append(input_len + output_len)
            if len(examples) < 2:
                examples.append({"rid": str(req["rid"]), "input_length": input_len,
                                 "recorded_prefix_length": prefix,
                                 "recorded_output_length": output_len,
                                 "source_derived_native_seq_len": input_len + output_len,

        n = len(req_infos)

        query_biases["legacy_prefix_only"].append(sum(prefixes) // n + 1 - expected_s)
        query_biases["runtime_prefix_plus_output"].append(sum(p + o for p, o in zip(prefixes, outputs)) // n + 1 - expected_s)
        query_biases["source_derived_history"].append(sum(length - 1 for length in physical_lengths) // n + 1 - expected_s)
    assert decode_batches and output_counts
    summaries = {}
    for name, values in query_biases.items():
        summaries[name] = {"batch_count": len(values), "mean_bias_tokens": statistics.mean(values),
                           "min_bias_tokens": min(values), "max_bias_tokens": max(values),
                           "nonzero_batch_count": sum(v != 0 for v in values),
                           "bias_histogram": dict(sorted(Counter(values).items()))}
    results.append({"model": model, "split": split, "case": case, "repeat": 1,

                    "decode_request_observations": len(output_counts),

                    "query_bias_relative_to_floor_mean_source_derived_native_seq_len": summaries,
